subject.title: [security] Azure and GCP credential identifiers are omitted from coordinator diagnostic redaction

question: Should coordinator diagnostics redact every configured provider-registry `requiredSecrets` value, including Azure/GCP account identifiers, as credential material?
rationale: The source and docs support the report, but accepting identifier redaction as the security boundary is a maintainer-owned security-policy call before shipping the fix.

options.title: Redact all required provider secrets
options.body: Treat the Azure/GCP identifiers as configured provider credential material and make the diagnostic redaction source registry-driven or otherwise complete.

options.title: Document identifiers as routing context
options.body: Keep those identifiers visible only if maintainers explicitly decide they are non-secret routing context and update the security guide to narrow the redaction promise.

options.title: Redact only selected identifiers
options.body: Patch the four reported values directly, but accept a higher chance of future provider-registry drift unless tests enforce the policy.

recommendation.title: Redact all required provider secrets
recommendation.body: Treat the Azure/GCP identifiers as configured provider credential material and make the diagnostic redaction source registry-driven or otherwise complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner is tied by blame to the current coordinator diagnostic helper, provider metadata, and security redaction documentation.
